description: Generate a step-by-step dated timeline for a private (non-HDB) resale purchase, with the 1% option fee, 4% exercise payment, stamp duties and completion payment at the right steps. Exercise date defaults to 14 calendar days inclusive of the option date if not entered.

buyerType.description: Residency or legal status of the buyer; sets the ABSD rate.

completionDate.description: Completion date (ISO 8601). Defaults to exerciseDate + 70 calendar days if not provided.

cpfUsage.description: CPF OA savings the buyer will put towards the purchase, in SGD. Drawn down in step order against the legal fee and completion payment, the only payments CPF may make; each payment reports its `cpf` and `cash` parts.

exerciseDate.description: Exercise date (ISO 8601). Defaults to optionDate + 13 calendar days if not provided.

existingPropertiesOwned.description: Residential properties the buyer already owns; sets the ABSD tier.

interestRate.description: Annual loan interest rate, as a percentage (e.g. 3.5 = 3.5%). Supply with tenureYears to get `funding.monthlyInstalment`; otherwise it is null.

legalFee.description: Conveyancing fee for the purchase, in SGD; part of the total outlay.

loanAmount.description: Housing loan amount, in SGD; 0 for a cash purchase. Sets the LTV band, the minimum cash and the completion payment.

optionExpiryDate.description: Last day to exercise the option (ISO 8601).

otherFees.description: Other costs (valuation, repairs, admin), in SGD. Reported alongside legal fees and stamp duty as part of the total outlay.

purchasePrice.description: Agreed purchase price of the private property, in SGD; sets the option fee, exercise payment, stamp duties and downpayment.

tenureYears.description: Loan tenure in years. Supply with interestRate to get `funding.monthlyInstalment`.

name: calculate_private_resale_timeline

completionDateIsDefault.description: True if the completion date was defaulted (not entered).

completionDateUsed.description: The completion date used (entered or defaulted).

exerciseDateIsDefault.description: True if the exercise date was defaulted (not entered).

exerciseDateUsed.description: The exercise date used (entered or defaulted).

cashOrCpf.description: Remainder of the downpayment, payable in cash or CPF OA, in SGD.

downpaymentPercent.description: Downpayment as a fraction of the purchase price (0.25 = 25%).

downpaymentTotal.description: Purchase price less the loan, in SGD.

ltv.description: Loan as a fraction of the purchase price (0.75 = 75%).

minimumCash.description: Minimum cash portion of the downpayment, in SGD.

minimumCashPercent.description: Minimum cash portion required, as a fraction of the price (0.05 = 5%).

monthlyInstalment.description: Monthly instalment, in SGD, or null when no rate and tenure were supplied.

otherFees.description: Other costs supplied by the caller, in SGD.

absd.description: Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty, in SGD.

anchor.description: Which anchor date this step is relative to.

date.description: Computed date (ISO 8601), or null for sequence-only steps.

dayOffset.description: Day offset from the anchor date, or null.

amount.description: Payment due at this step, in SGD.

cash.description: Part paid in cash, in SGD (amount less cpf).

cpf.description: Part paid from the CPF given as cpfUsage, in SGD. Only the legal fee and completion payment (and, for HDB resale, stamp duty) may use CPF.

payment.description: Payment due at this step, or null if no payment.

completionDate.description: Date of the final dated step (ISO 8601).

durationDays.description: Elapsed days from option date to completion.

totalCash.description: Part of totalPayments paid in cash, in SGD.

totalCpf.description: Part of totalPayments paid from CPF, in SGD.

totalPayments.description: Sum of all payments across the timeline, in SGD.

title: Private resale purchase timeline
